verdict.rationale: The OpenHands GitHub README says users can create automations and workflows that integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear and more, and "run on a schedule or in response to webhook events." The docs add Agent Canvas as the control center for automations, plus concrete automation templates such as PR triage that prompts authors on stale PRs. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of schedule configuration (cron/interval syntax, timezone, managing, pausing or editing recurring runs), run history or monitoring of scheduled jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduling works as described.
